config_hash: analysis-only: the stored per-draw components of the single P-V3-1 surviving miss cell (tickets, alpha 0.05, temper gamma 0.5, beta 5.982; 25/30 covered, median bound 5.0x its excess), registered before the components were examined
evidence_tier: EVIDENCE-TIER DATA, analysis registration, honoring the P-V3-1 falsifier's commitment: the surviving cell's draw-tail fragility gets a registered diagnosis before any prose narrates it.

predictions.P-DT1: The five uncovered draws' bound dips are driven predominantly by the a_plugin term (the plug-in's target-and-source sampling variance at an extreme tilt), not by cal_err or b_own: across the 30 draws, the bound's correlation with its a_plugin component exceeds its correlation with each other component, and the five uncovered draws all sit in the bottom ten of a_plugin.

falsifiers.P-DT1: If the dips are b_own-driven instead, the fat per-draw b_own tail (the P-V3-4 miss) is not just a pricing distribution fact but an under-coverage mechanism, and the certificate's crossing-margin term needs a floor of its own before prose.

decision_rule: Pearson correlations of per-draw bound with each component over the 30 stored draws; rank check of the uncovered draws within each component.

amendments.what: Stage 2 added BEFORE running it: per-draw-paired coverage on the miss cell (each of 100 draws pairs one certificate with the SAME draw's realized excess on a 10000-case window, the R1-2 object). Prediction P-DT2: per-draw coverage >= 90%; the registered falsifier's b_own-floor prescription is adopted only if this fails.
amendments.why: P-DT1's data showed whole-draw co-movement through the calibration draw's threshold location (all four components rank the five uncovered draws bottom-five; correlations 0.92 to 0.98), which is neither registered branch; a high-threshold draw genuinely carries less risk, so the cell-mean comparison may mismatch objects exactly as R1-2 found.

verdicts.P-DT1: MISS, filed verbatim: no single component owns the dips. All four components rank the five uncovered draws bottom-five simultaneously (correlations with the bound 0.92 to 0.98; b_own highest at 0.975): the shared randomness is the calibration draw's threshold location.
verdicts.P-DT2: MISS, decisive: object-matched per-draw coverage is 84/100 (registered >= 90), breach p90 +0.012. The fragility is genuine.
verdicts.closure: The registered falsifier's prescription tested and adopted: flooring the crossing-margin credit lifts the same 100 draws to 99/100 at a global mean price of +0.0057 (computed from the stored v3 per-draw values). Certificate v3.1; the exact 674-cell recompute gives 674/674.
